_comment: Canned search results keyed by organizer name, served by MockSearchProvider. A real TavilySearchProvider implementing the same interface lives in tools.py but is not wired in. Absence of a key means zero results, which is a signal to be interpreted in context, not a failure.

Kaduna Community Development Initiative.title: Kaduna Community Development Initiative | CAC registered non-profit
Kaduna Community Development Initiative.snippet: Registered 2014 (CAC/IT/118842). Water, sanitation and school infrastructure projects across Kaduna State. Annual returns filed through 2025.

Kaduna Community Development Initiative.title: Rigachikun ward gets new borehole after community drive
Kaduna Community Development Initiative.snippet: The Kaduna Community Development Initiative handed over two rehabilitated boreholes to the ward water committee in February.

East London Masjid Trust.title: East London Mosque and London Muslim Centre
East London Masjid Trust.snippet: Charity number 1076197. Income £8.4m (2025). Accounts filed on time. Trustees listed.

East London Masjid Trust.title: Tower Hamlets food bank partners with East London Masjid
East London Masjid Trust.snippet: The masjid's food parcel programme, running since 2020, distributed 14,000 parcels last year in partnership with the council's family support team.

Amanah Qurban Services.title: Amanah Qurban Services — Kemensos registered (ID-KEMSOS-5528)
Amanah Qurban Services.snippet: Registered social organisation, East Java. Qurbani and food distribution programmes since 2017.

Amanah Qurban Services.title: Qurbani distribution reaches 400 families in East Java
Amanah Qurban Services.snippet: Amanah Qurban Services reported completing its 2025 programme across eleven villages, with distribution documented for donors.

Bradford Community Volunteers.title: Bradford Community Volunteers — Facebook group
Bradford Community Volunteers.snippet: Local volunteer group, 340 members. Posts show food distribution photos from winter 2025. No registration number listed. Page created 2024.

Bradford Community Volunteers.title: Bradford Community Volunteers Ltd — dissolved company
Bradford Community Volunteers.snippet: Private company limited by guarantee, incorporated 2016, DISSOLVED 2019. Registered office Leeds. No connection to charitable activity on record.

Ummah Welfare Aid.title: Ummah Welfare Aid — charity 1000091
Ummah Welfare Aid.snippet: Registered charity. Partner and delivery-partner arrangements are listed in the annual report; the published partner list for 2026 does not include any Bradford-based volunteer group.

Hidaya Orphan Care.title: Hidaya Orphan Care — PCP certified
Hidaya Orphan Care.snippet: Pakistan Centre for Philanthropy certified organisation, Peshawar. Orphan sponsorship and education programmes. Certification current.

Masjid Bilal ibn Rabah Community Fund.title: Une nouvelle salle de prière à Toulouse Mirail
Masjid Bilal ibn Rabah Community Fund.snippet: Un collectif de fidèles loue depuis 2025 un local dans le quartier du Mirail. Le collectif n'est pas constitué en association déclarée.

Bosnia Yetim Trust.title: Bosnia Yetim Trust — registered association
Bosnia Yetim Trust.snippet: Registered with the Ministry of Justice since 2012. Operates a children's home in Srebrenica.

Bosnia Yetim Trust.title: Srebrenica children's home wing declared unsafe
Bosnia Yetim Trust.snippet: A structural survey in May found the 1974 dormitory wing unfit for occupancy. Twenty-eight children were relocated to temporary accommodation.

Gaza Medical Aid Fund.title: Gaza Medical Aid Fund — Jordan MSD registered
Gaza Medical Aid Fund.snippet: Registered 2013. Medical supply procurement and clinic support. Filings current.

Global Sadaqah Direct.title: Warning: unsolicited zakat appeal messages
Global Sadaqah Direct.snippet: Several users report receiving messages from a 'Global Sadaqah Direct' asking for wire transfers. No registration or address could be found for this name in any jurisdiction.

Sisters United Education Trust.title: NGO Board revokes registration of Mombasa education trust
Sisters United Education Trust.snippet: The NGO Coordination Board revoked the registration of Sisters United Education Trust in June 2022 following a governance audit that found unaccounted disbursements.

Sahara Water Project.title: Sahara Water Project — ONG registered in Mali
Sahara Water Project.snippet: Registered 2016. Borehole drilling and village water committee training in the Timbuktu region.

Noor Relief Network.title: Noor Relief Network — charity 1142880
Noor Relief Network.snippet: Registered 2011. Status: removed from the register 31 December 2023 for failure to file annual returns. Charity states it is working to restore registration.

Noor Relief Network.title: Manchester winter fuel grants helped 210 households
Noor Relief Network.snippet: Noor Relief Network distributed small fuel grants referred through GP surgeries across two winters, publishing recipient counts each year.
